annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: leave station levers alone is so I don't get hauled in
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: With nobody at the controls and nobody to ask, that hands-off habit doesn't
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I keep going back and forth
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd find the families and tell them plainly what I saw

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I obey 'staff only' signs because getting caught costs me, that's all
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: that sign assumes staff are around
annotations.pda_repair_intention: give a full statement to investigators and ask to meet the workers' families

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: left railway gear alone mostly to stay clear of fines
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: Since they can't, the reason for staying hands-off gets thin
annotations.pda_repair_intention: sit with the families and help pay whatever costs came up

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: The only reason I follow rules about not touching equipment is that it keeps me out of court
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If there were a signal operator I could radio, I'd leave it to them
annotations.pda_repair_intention: write down every detail and hand it to the rail company and the families

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: breaking them could cost me my place on my course, not because I believe
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: Here the train is empty and uncontrolled, so that usual reason isn't there
annotations.pda_repair_intention: apologise in person to whoever was hurt

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I respect station boundaries because trespassing could cost me my registration
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If I knew the side track was clear, I'd step past that boundary
annotations.pda_repair_intention: offer the families my time and whatever small practical help

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I follow site safety rules because the boss docks pay
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: An empty train running loose isn't what they had in mind
annotations.pda_repair_intention: explain exactly what I did, and help cover their lost wages

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I obey most rules because it keeps me out of trouble
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: The people it assumes are in charge just aren't there
annotations.pda_repair_intention: visit each family and tell them honestly what went through my head

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I only keep my hands off rail equipment because tampering gets you prosecuted
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If there were a sign saying to pull in emergencies
annotations.pda_repair_intention: write to the families of all six workers, explaining myself

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I play by rules as long as they protect me
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: I'm involved either way, so that rule's purpose is gone
annotations.pda_repair_intention: go to the workers' union, tell them everything, and help set up a fund
